title: Dynamic Cogeneration of Bug Reproduction Test in Agentic Program Repair
year_venue: 2026 FSE Companion / industry-track paper; arXiv v3 dated 2026-08-21; CC BY 4.0
datasets: 120 Google-internal GITS bugs across C++, Dart, Go, Java, Kotlin, Python
SWT-Bench is related work, not experimental data
models: Gemini 2.5 Pro (generation temp 0.2, top-p 0.95; spec reviewer temp 0.0, top-p 0.95)
license: CC BY 4.0 paper; no public software/data license because Passerine and GITS cohort are private
input_setting: Internal bug report and pre-fix Google monorepo; cogenerate a repair patch and BRT; validate against internal oracle patch/BRT
concept_hook: Co-generate root-cause-oriented fix and BRT; compare TDD, TLD and Freeform; qualitatively diagnose test/fix-agent failures
limitation: Private GITS dataset, source, Passerine, test infrastructure and trajectories; no Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT experimental tasks
